branches.name: Computer Science and Engineering
branches.overview: Computer Science and Engineering is the study of computational systems, software development, algorithms, and data structures. Students learn to design and build software systems, work with artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, and more. CSE is the most sought-after branch in IITs due to its excellent placement records and versatile career options across tech, finance, and research.

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Design, develop, and maintain software applications and systems at scale. Work on everything from mobile apps to distributed cloud infrastructure.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Analyze complex datasets using statistical methods and machine learning to extract insights and drive business decisions.

careers.title: AI/ML Engineer
careers.description: Build and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning models for real-world applications like NLP, computer vision, and recommendation systems.

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.description: Lead product strategy, define roadmaps, and work cross-functionally to build products that users love.

careers.title: Quantitative Analyst
careers.description: Use mathematical models and programming to analyze financial markets and develop trading strategies.

careers.title: Startup Founder
careers.description: Build your own technology company from scratch. IIT CSE alumni have founded many successful startups.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy solving logical puzzles and brain teasers?
Are you interested in building apps or websites?
Do you like mathematics and abstract thinking?
Are you fascinated by artificial intelligence and automation?
Can you spend hours debugging a program without getting frustrated?

branches.name: Electrical Engineering
branches.overview: Electrical Engineering focuses on the study of electrical systems, power generation, electronics, control systems, and signal processing. It bridges hardware and software, giving graduates versatility to work in power, semiconductors, telecommunications, and even software. EE is one of the top branches in IITs with excellent placements across core and non-core sectors.

careers.title: Power Systems Engineer
careers.description: Design and maintain electrical power systems for generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity.

careers.title: VLSI Design Engineer
careers.description: Design integrated circuits and semiconductor chips used in processors, memory, and other electronic components.

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Many EE graduates transition to software roles due to strong analytical and programming foundations.

careers.title: Signal Processing Engineer
careers.description: Work on processing, analyzing, and interpreting signals for telecommunications, audio, and image systems.

careers.title: Control Systems Engineer
careers.description: Design automation and control systems for manufacturing, robotics, and industrial processes.

careers.title: Research Scientist
careers.description: Pursue cutting-edge research in areas like quantum computing, renewable energy, or semiconductor physics.

quiz.question: Are you interested in how electrical circuits and systems work?
Do you enjoy working with hardware and electronic gadgets?
Are you comfortable with advanced mathematics?
Are you interested in semiconductors and chip design?
Do you like understanding how signals and communication systems work?

branches.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
branches.overview: ECE bridges hardware and software, focusing on electronic devices, circuits, communication equipment, and embedded systems.

careers.title: VLSI Engineer
careers.description: Design semiconductor chips.

quiz.question: Are you interested in how hardware and software integrate?

branches.name: Mechanical Engineering
branches.overview: Mechanical Engineering is one of the broadest and oldest engineering disciplines, covering thermodynamics, mechanics, material science, manufacturing, and robotics. Students learn to design, analyze, and build physical systems from automobiles to spacecraft. The branch offers diverse career paths in automotive, aerospace, energy, manufacturing, and increasingly in robotics and automation.

careers.title: Design Engineer
careers.description: Design mechanical components and systems using CAD software for automotive, aerospace, and consumer products.

careers.title: Automotive Engineer
careers.description: Develop and improve vehicle systems including powertrain, chassis, and EV technology.

careers.title: Robotics Engineer
careers.description: Design, build, and program robots for industrial automation, healthcare, and consumer applications.

careers.title: Management Consultant
careers.description: Many ME graduates pivot to consulting using their analytical and problem-solving skills.

careers.title: Energy Engineer
careers.description: Work on power generation, renewable energy systems, and energy efficiency in buildings and industry.

careers.title: Manufacturing Engineer
careers.description: Optimize manufacturing processes and quality control in factories and production facilities.

quiz.question: Do you like understanding how machines and engines work?
Are you interested in building or designing physical products?
Do you enjoy physics, especially mechanics and thermodynamics?
Are you interested in automobiles, robotics, or aerospace?
Do you like hands-on work with tools and workshops?

branches.name: Civil Engineering
branches.overview: Civil Engineering deals with the design, construction, and maintenance of infrastructure — buildings, bridges, roads, dams, and water systems. It is fundamental to nation-building and offers careers in construction, urban planning, environmental engineering, and project management. Civil Engineering is ideal for those passionate about creating lasting physical structures that serve society.

careers.title: Structural Engineer
careers.description: Design and analyze structures like buildings, bridges, and dams to ensure safety and stability.

careers.title: Construction Manager
careers.description: Manage large-scale construction projects, coordinating teams, budgets, and timelines.

careers.title: Urban Planner
careers.description: Plan and design cities, towns, and urban spaces for sustainable development.

careers.title: Environmental Engineer
careers.description: Work on water treatment, waste management, and environmental remediation projects.

careers.title: Government Services (IAS/IES)
careers.description: Many civil engineers pursue Indian Engineering Services or IAS for impactful government careers.

careers.title: Transportation Engineer
careers.description: Design road networks, highway systems, and public transit infrastructure.

quiz.question: Are you interested in how bridges, buildings, and dams are built?
Do you care about sustainable city planning and infrastructure?
Are you comfortable with fieldwork and site visits?
Do you like physics, especially mechanics and structures?
Are you drawn to government or public service careers?

branches.name: Chemical Engineering
branches.overview: Chemical Engineering combines chemistry, physics, mathematics, and biology to design and optimize processes for producing chemicals, fuels, pharmaceuticals, food, and materials at industrial scale. It is critical to industries like petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, FMCG, and emerging fields like biotechnology and sustainable energy. Chemical engineers are among the most versatile engineers.

careers.title: Process Engineer
careers.description: Design and optimize chemical manufacturing processes for efficiency, safety, and cost-effectiveness.

careers.title: Pharmaceutical Engineer
careers.description: Develop and scale-up drug manufacturing processes in pharmaceutical companies.

careers.title: Data Analyst / Consultant
careers.description: Many chemical engineers use their analytical skills to transition into consulting or analytics roles.

careers.title: Environmental Engineer
careers.description: Design systems for pollution control, waste treatment, and sustainable industrial processes.

careers.title: Materials Scientist
careers.description: Research and develop new materials for applications in energy, electronics, and manufacturing.

careers.title: Petroleum Engineer
careers.description: Work on extraction, refining, and processing of crude oil and natural gas.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy chemistry and chemical reactions?
Are you interested in how factories and industrial plants work?
Do you care about environmental sustainability and clean energy?
Are you interested in pharmaceuticals and drug development?
Do you like optimizing processes and making things more efficient?

branches.name: Aerospace Engineering
branches.overview: Aerospace Engineering deals with the design, development, and testing of aircraft, spacecraft, satellites, and missiles. It combines aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, and control systems. This branch is ideal for those fascinated by flight, space exploration, and defense technology. With India's growing space and defense sectors (ISRO, HAL, DRDO), aerospace offers exciting career opportunities.

careers.title: Aerospace Design Engineer
careers.description: Design aircraft, spacecraft, and satellite systems using advanced simulation and CAD tools.

careers.title: Propulsion Engineer
careers.description: Design and develop rocket engines, jet engines, and propulsion systems for aircraft and spacecraft.

careers.title: Satellite Systems Engineer
careers.description: Design and operate satellite systems for communication, navigation, and remote sensing.

careers.title: Defense Scientist
careers.description: Work on missile systems, fighter aircraft, and defense technology for national security.

careers.title: UAV/Drone Engineer
careers.description: Design and develop unmanned aerial vehicles for commercial, agricultural, and defense applications.

careers.title: Research Scientist
careers.description: Pursue advanced research in aerodynamics, propulsion, space science, or materials at universities and labs.

quiz.question: Are you fascinated by aircraft, rockets, and space exploration?
Do you enjoy physics, especially mechanics and fluid dynamics?
Are you interested in defense technology and national security?
Can you handle highly rigorous academic coursework?
Do you dream of designing satellites or space missions?

branches.name: Engineering Physics
branches.overview: Engineering Physics bridges the gap between theoretical physics and practical engineering applications. Students study quantum mechanics, semiconductor physics, optics, nanotechnology, and computational physics. This branch produces highly analytical graduates who excel in research, semiconductors, data science, and cutting-edge technology development. It is offered at a limited number of IITs and attracts students who love deep scientific exploration.

careers.title: Research Scientist
careers.description: Conduct fundamental research in physics, materials science, quantum computing, or nanotechnology at top institutions.

careers.title: Semiconductor Engineer
careers.description: Work on semiconductor device design, fabrication, and testing for the chip industry.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Apply strong mathematical and computational skills to data science and machine learning problems.

careers.title: Quantitative Analyst
careers.description: Use advanced physics and mathematics skills for quantitative finance and algorithmic trading.

careers.title: Photonics Engineer
careers.description: Design optical systems, lasers, and fiber-optic communication systems.

careers.title: Quantum Computing Researcher
careers.description: Work on the cutting edge of quantum computing hardware and algorithms.

quiz.question: Do you love physics and want to explore it deeply?
Are you comfortable with very advanced mathematics?
Are you interested in quantum computing or nanotechnology?
Do you enjoy doing experiments and scientific research?
Are you open to pursuing higher studies (MS/PhD)?
